records.title: State-conditioned modifier application detaches nested posture envelope state
adjudication_notes: The existing Tier A state-conditioned modifier family was extended before source repair to prove modifier application does not share nested posture-envelope state with its input posture object.
The pre-repair targeted proof failed because apply_posture_modifiers shallow-copied local_envelope, allowing mutation of nested output payloads to alter the input posture envelope.
The bounded repair added a deep copy at the modifier application boundary and repaired the clean-bundle proof command for the existing dynamic coefficient/modifier proof block.
non_claims: Does not prove every coefficient/modifier donor obligation.
